blocks.text: Búzios grew from a fishing village and is known for its distinctive landscape, tropical vegetation and picturesque beaches. After the busy days in Rio, this part of the trip offers a peaceful break by the ocean.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The verified Word 2027 has an itinerary passage about Búzios (p:85), but no separate concluding body paragraph covering the RU wording on terrain and tropical vegetation. This distinct RU body block is translated without copying the shared day description.
